name: Somchai Wongthanakit
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport started unconventionally. While serving in the Royal Thai Air Force as a maintenance technician, his meticulous approach to aircraft engine repair caught the eye of a local racing team owner. Intrigued by the precision engineering required, Somchai made the leap from aircraft to racing cars, quickly establishing himself as a reliable and adaptable machinist.

His philosophy revolves around understanding the holistic impact of every component. Somchai doesn't just fix parts; he analyzes the entire system to optimize performance and prevent future failures. This big-picture thinking, combined with his unwavering attention to detail, makes him a valuable asset to MP Motorsport. He is known for his ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues under pressure, often finding innovative solutions that others miss.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave at the front
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a wiry build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of humming softly while working, often Thai folk songs.
Refuses to start any major repair without first taking a sip of strong, sweet Thai iced tea.
